name: 環形太空站
description: 坐在環形太空站的軌道列車上，城市沿圓筒內壁升起、越過玻璃拱窗、在頭頂倒掛而過；執行時列車加速，等你時停車、維修工出現。
description_en: Ride an orbital train inside a ring station: the city climbs the cylinder wall, passes a glass arch and hangs upside down overhead. The train speeds up while Claude works and stops when it needs you.
